mobile.sidebar.view_options.note: Accessible name of the small sliders icon beside the drawer's search pill, and the title of the compact sheet it opens. Mirrors the desktop's 'View options' (ui.chat.sidebar.header.view_options).

mobile.sidebar.order_by.note: Label of the choice of how conversations are ordered in the drawer. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.order_by.

mobile.sidebar.order.active_first.note: Order option: conversations with a turn running, or waiting on the reader, are lifted to the top; the rest follow newest first. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.active_first.

mobile.sidebar.order.most_recent.note: Order option: one newest-first order over every conversation, nothing lifted. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.most_recent.

mobile.sidebar.group_by.note: Label of the choice of how the drawer groups conversations. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.group_by.

mobile.sidebar.group.time_section.note: Grouping option: headed sections Pinned, Running, Today, This week, Older. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.time_section.

mobile.sidebar.group.one_list.note: Grouping option: one list with no section headings. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.one_list.

mobile.sidebar.time_basis.note: Label of the choice of which clock the sections, the row times and the order read. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.time_basis.

mobile.sidebar.basis.last_active.note: Clock option: when the conversation last had activity. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.last_active.

mobile.sidebar.basis.created.note: Clock option: when the conversation was started. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.created.

mobile.sidebar.clock_hint.note: One sentence under the clock choice explaining that it changes both the dates shown and the order. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.clock_hint.

mobile.sidebar.show_ended.note: Switch label: whether conversations whose session has ended stay in the drawer. Phone-only setting; on by default.

mobile.sidebar.show_ended_hint.note: One sentence under the 'Show ended sessions' switch: turning it off never hides a pinned or running conversation.

mobile.sidebar.sections.note: Label of the list of switches that show or hide each drawer section. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.sections.

mobile.sidebar.section.pinned.note: Drawer section heading for conversations the reader pinned; also the switch label that shows or hides it. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.section.pinned.

mobile.sidebar.section.running.note: Drawer section heading for conversations with a turn in flight or waiting on the reader. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.section.running.

mobile.sidebar.section.today.note: Drawer section heading for conversations from this local calendar day. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.section.today.

mobile.sidebar.section.week.note: Drawer section heading for conversations from the last six calendar days, not today. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.section.week.

mobile.sidebar.section.older.note: Drawer section heading for everything older than this week. Desktop: ui.chat.sidebar_view.section.older.

mobile.sidebar.more_settings.note: Link at the foot of the drawer's View options sheet that opens the full Sidebar section in Settings.

mobile.sidebar.settings_heading.note: Heading of the Settings section holding every drawer (sidebar) view option.
